evidence: Built a criterion->public-requirement map for all 53 criteria (2 gates, 41 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual). Every graded demand traces to instruction.md, hireops_rules.md or a professional default; no criterion asserts an exact label, route, selector, field name, layout or reference-only rule. Prompts explicitly disclaim such demands (functional/prompt.md:15 'Do not require routes, selectors, field names, layouts or exact wording'; app_context.md:33-34; visual/prompt.md:14 'Layout, labels and styles are the implementer's choice... No phone layout or theme switching is required', matching instruction.md:11). Representative mapping: hro_gate_render wrong-password signed out -> rules s1 (sign-in, known FP per SKILL.md:63); hro_gate_shared/hro_job_open team, manager, places 1-50 whole, HM-account-only -> rules s2 'whole number from 1 to 50', 'chosen from the hiring-manager accounts' (blank title refusal = professional default of 'A job has a title'); hro_add_email_rules 'shown at the email field, typed name kept' -> rules s2 'say so at that field and keep what was typed'; hro_move_one_stage/hro_reject_hired/hro_reopen -> rules s3 Moving a card, with 'hiding it is optional' leniency; reopen-undo restoring reason -> rules s3 Undo 'restores a rejection reason that the move removed'; hro_arrive_bottom/hro_reorder -> 'goes to the bottom', 'moved up or down... with ordinary controls'; hro_interview_full/_reorder_free/hro_undo_full -> Interview places + Undo 'or if it would overfill Interview'; hro_refused_put_back focus on card control -> rules 'keyboard focus stays on that card's controls' (criterion is more lenient: client-side pre-refusal also passes); hro_mgr_* -> Who may move what + s1/s2 recruiter-only open/add; hro_anonymous exact 401 -> rules s1 'A caller with no valid session reads and writes nothing: 401'; hro_stale_refused 'by whom' -> s3 Two people at once (identifier mapped via staff data also accepted); hro_bulk_* board order Y,W,X and A2,V -> s3 Moving several together 'by stage... then by place'; hro_undo_conflict reorder-by-other blocks undo -> 'moved, re-ordered, rejected or reopened since, by anyone'; note does not block -> 'Adding a note does not count'; hro_undo_once -> 'earlier move is no longer undoable once the same person has made a later one'; hro_activity newest-first, filter, re-orderings, undos, reason; notes excluded -> rules s4 list (notes not in it); hro_msg_compose Enter/Shift+Enter/empty+focused -> s6 Messages; hro_thread_latest/earlier 30, remaining count -> s6 Long conversations; hro_unread_* incl. totals and 'how many new' notice -> s6 Unread; hro_seen observer never counts -> s6 Seen; hro_thread_access -> s6 Who takes part; hro_drafts/hro_pol_session_resume (survive sign-out, hidden from Mei) -> instruction.md:7 'stays... when I... get signed out... nobody else who signs in on that browser sees it' and rules s6 Drafts 'after the session ends mid-reply'; note-draft legs -> rules s3 Internal notes 'kept for that person on that browser until it is saved'; hro_candidate_* wording table, 404 for others' apps, no notes/reason/rejected-from/place/others/activity -> rules s1, s7; hro_restart -> instruction.md:15 + integration.md; hro_pol_live_board/live_thread/earlier_place -> rules s5 and s6 Long conversations ('the message that was at the top of the view stays where it was'); hro_pol_failed_send -> s6 'stays in the box, and the person is told'; visual Likert rows are professional craft defaults for 'A clear desktop workspace'. Fixed seed-derived expectations verified against seed_data.json: Platform Engineer Applied Greta(1), Ade(2), Marco(3), Screen Priya(1), Samuel(2); Noor APP-101 note 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.'; Lena APP-301 has 3 messages and USR-CAN3 read_count 2 -> unread 1 (third message by USR-REC3). Borderline but acceptable: hro_reject_reason requires staff to read the rejected-from stage somewhere (card, details, reopen control or Activity line); rules s3 only says 'The workspace remembers' it, but s4 requires every rejection line to say 'what changed' (a stage change, cf. the 'from Screen to Interview' example), so a conforming app exposes it via Activity; low false-fail risk. Risk=true for two reasons: (1) no configured judge run of the golden or any conforming alternative exists (raw-evidence-index scope: 'Full configured grading/workload... are absent'), so 'no false-fail on correct apps' is unmeasured at runtime; (2) latent cross-dimension fixture dependency: hro_unread_counts asserts an absolute 'Lena Fischer starts with 1 unread' (functional/judge.toml hro_unread_counts; protocol Z), but scored dimensions share one app instance (test.sh run_suite scored, max-concurrent-agent 1, no reset) and polish hro_pol_failed_send and hro_pol_session_resume let Rafael send into 'a conversation'/'one conversation' unspecified; if polish runs before functional and picks Lena's Product Designer conversation, a correct app reads 2 and fails. Dimension order inside rewardkit was not verified (source unavailable). Not a hidden requirement, so not a Fail of this row.
counterexample: Attempted: (a) plausible broken app that could pass - a drag-only board or one without per-card versions; criteria still fail it (hro_move_one_stage/hro_reorder require non-drag controls; hro_stale_refused replays the exact stale request). (b) conforming alternative that could fail - an app with different routes/labels/layout, a websocket/SSE/polling transport, no visible 'Seen' state until seen, a client-side pre-refusal for full Interview, or one Activity line per multi-card move: each is explicitly accepted by the prompts/criteria. No conforming alternative was found that fails because a criterion demands something unrequired. Residual latent case (fixture, not hidden requirement): a correct app where polish ran first and the polish judge sent its failed-send/session-resume message in Lena Fischer's Product Designer conversation would show Lena 2 unread and lose hro_unread_counts.
suggested_fix: Optional hardening (P3): in polish hro_pol_failed_send and hro_pol_session_resume name Noor Haddad's Platform Engineer conversation (or forbid Lena Fischer's Product Designer conversation) so functional protocol Z's absolute 'Lena starts with 1' cannot be disturbed by dimension order; obtain a configured judge run on the golden to measure absence of false fails.
